title: GieesK Signature Ethiopian Café Meal
localName: ጊኤስኬ ፊርማ ምግብ — GieesK Firma Mgib
community: GieesK Recipes — the signature modern Ethiopian dining experience
author: Chef Haile
desc: GieesK Signature Ethiopian Café Meal — the complete modern Ethiopian dining experience: Berbere Grilled Chicken (ETH282), Modern Tibs Bowl (ETH283), Modern Vegetarian Platter (ETH292), Coffee Cheesecake (ETH287), and the Ethiopian Coffee Ceremony (ETH211). Modern Ethiopia at its finest.
longDesc: The GieesK Signature Meal is the modern Ethiopian dining experience at its peak — the best of traditional Ethiopian cooking presented with contemporary precision, alongside the modern café innovations that represent Ethiopia's culinary future.
ingredients: // Honey Latte (ETH296) as the café drink
steps: Day before: marinate chicken (ETH282). Make cheesecake.
Day of: all fasting dishes for vegetarian platter.
Dinner service: grill chicken. Make tibs bowl fresh.
chefTips: The coffee ceremony is the heart of the meal — plan it as the finale.
The vegetarian platter is assembled first and held warm while the meat dishes are prepared fresh.
This is a 2-hour dining experience — plan accordingly.
commonMistakes: Serving the coffee ceremony before the meal.
sustainabilityTips: The GieesK Signature Meal is the modern expression of Ethiopian food philosophy: maximum flavour, maximum nutrition, maximum cultural identity.
healthBenefits: The GieesK Signature Meal provides complete nutrition from every food group — protein (chicken, beef), plant-based (vegetarian platter), dairy (ayib, cheesecake), and the most antioxidant-rich coffee on earth.
culturalNote: The GieesK Signature Ethiopian Café Meal is our vision of modern Ethiopian dining — honouring every tradition (the coffee ceremony, the berbere, the injera) while embracing the contemporary café culture that young Ethiopians have built. It is the old and the new together, as they should be.
